exposure: conception by means of in vitro fertilization (IVF)
cohort: 3,283 women with singleton pregnancies delivering in Uppsala from 2010 to 2015
finding: Conception via IVF was not associated with maternal depressive symptoms during pregnancy or postpartum.
mod_finding: This study found that despite the higher rate of cesarean delivery in the IVF group, mode of conception (IVF vs. spontaneous) was not associated with maternal depressive symptoms during pregnancy or postpartum.
